detail: R-weight-json-symlink-and-absent-tests-pin-24b3: weight.json symlink and absent tests pin only what is not printed

data.title: weight.json symlink and absent tests pin only what is not printed
data.label: RISK
data.what: test_a_symlinked_weight_json_leaves_the_mirror_to_the_text_merge and test_an_absent_weight_json_leaves_the_mirror_to_the_text_merge check no rc and no positive outcome; with the islink guard at update.py:900 removed the symlink test can still pass (B1 review M1, L1)
data.fix: assert rc and the text-merge outcome for weight.md; show the symlink test fails with the guard removed

detail: R-adopt-test-env-filter-strips-riskrails-n-d45b: adopt test env filter strips RISKRAILS_ names by list, not by prefix

data.title: adopt test env filter strips RISKRAILS_ names by list, not by prefix
data.label: RISK
data.what: RISKRAILS_NOW, RISKRAILS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK and RISKRAILS_REGISTRY_URL still leak into the adopt tests; the other test files strip RISKRAILS_* by prefix (B1 review L2)
data.fix: use not k.startswith("RISKRAILS_") as the other files do

data.title: adopt --apply exit 2 is undocumented
data.label: KNOWN FACT
data.what: apply_run's docstring lists exits 0, 3, 4, 5 and skills/rr-setup/SKILL.md:197-198 documents only 5 and 4 for --adopt; exit 2 (TableError, now SchemaError) is missing
data.fix: add exit 2 to the docstring and rr-setup SKILL.md in a docs task
data.status_why: apply_run docstring and skills/rr-setup/SKILL.md list exit 2 (T-2026-10-30-2217 B1)

data.title: adopt SchemaError test hardcodes migration 0012
data.label: RISK
data.what: the synthetic 0012_bad_note.py / VERSION = 12 is added to a copy of the real registry; when a real 0012 ships, load() raises duplicate migration and the note-must-be-str assertion fails (loudly)
data.fix: derive the number from max(NNNN in the copied dir) + 1 for both file name and VERSION
data.status_why: synthetic migration number derived as registry max + 1 (T-2026-10-30-2217 B1)

detail: R-adopt-schemaerror-test-does-not-pin-stde-4667: adopt SchemaError test does not pin stderr or an unchanged tree

data.title: adopt SchemaError test does not pin stderr or an unchanged tree
data.label: RISK
data.what: test_apply_reports_a_migration_schema_error_as_exit_2_not_a_traceback merges stderr into stdout and compares no tree_sha, so a handler printing to stdout or writing before exit 2 would still pass
data.fix: run once without merge, assert the reason is not on stdout; compare tree_sha before and after as assert_refused does
data.status_why: test pins tree_sha unchanged and the reason not on stdout (T-2026-10-30-2217 B1)

detail: R-adopt-test-env-filters-keep-riskrails-mi-d971: adopt test env filters keep RISKRAILS_MIGRATIONS and RISKRAILS_TEST

data.title: adopt test env filters keep RISKRAILS_MIGRATIONS and RISKRAILS_TEST
data.label: RISK
data.what: migrations/__init__.py:20 reads RISKRAILS_MIGRATIONS before CLAUDE_AGENTIC_MIGRATIONS; a shell exporting it overrides every test that redirects the registry (fails loudly, predates this change)
data.fix: strip both RISKRAILS_* names in all test env filters in one separate task
data.status_why: adopt setUpClass strips RISKRAILS_MIGRATIONS/TEMPLATES/TEST/SHARED; other test files already strip RISKRAILS_* by prefix (residual: new risk for NOW/NO_UPDATE_CHECK/REGISTRY_URL) (T-2026-10-30-2217 B1)

data.title: weight_mirror fallbacks partly untested
data.label: RISK
data.what: Covered: faithful mirror, merged JSON, hand-edited mirror. Not covered: stale mirror, missing weight.md, valid JSON of the wrong shape (except branch), symlinked or absent weight.json (review M2 of T-2026-10-30-1347).
data.status_why: three characterization tests: missing weight.md, symlinked and absent weight.json (residual vacuity recorded as a new risk) (T-2026-10-30-2217 B1)
